name: Keep the Party Going
text:
Trigger An ally you can see is reduced to 0 HP.

---
Though your friends might fall, you're determined to be the last one standing. Attempt a DC @self.level Performance check check against a standard DC of your level.

---
Critical Success You grant yourself or one ally within 30 feet of you temporary Hit Points equal to double your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

Success As critical success, but the temporary Hit Points are equal to your level.
